request:
Which Python files under the rich/ folder import rich/console.py but never import rich/text.py? Count import statements anywhere in a file (top level, type-checking-only blocks, inside functions, and `__main__` demo blocks). Only imports that name the console or text module itself count, not imports of the rich package; rich/text.py qualifies if it imports rich/console.py. Give the repository-relative file paths.

Requested output columns: file_id (string).
explanation: Finds files under rich/ that have at least one import resolving to rich/console.py, then excludes any file that also has an import resolving to rich/text.py. All import rows are considered regardless of location, and only imports naming the module itself resolve to those file IDs.
